description:
The Lectric XP Trike2 is freedom on three wheels! It accommodates a wide range of rider abilities and preferences with our lowest standover height ever of just 13.8 inches. Capable, comfortable, and completely foldable, the XP Trike2 is the best-selling electric trike in America. Now available in six new color options, the updated hydroformed frame has been redesigned with comfort and convenience in mind. Featuring our new Cloud 50 suspension fork for a smoother ride, a 9-degree stem position for improved posture, and an adjusted seating position for more stability. This ride is big on fun and easy on the joints!
The XP Trike2 comes in two performance options, allowing you to choose how you want to ride. The 500W model is packed with upgrades and a refreshed frame design—all at the same unbeatable price. The 750W long-range model offers more power, more range, added hauling capability, and a torque sensor for a natural, intuitive ride feel.

components.description: The front wheel features a thru-axle wheel attachment system for a quick and easy installation. This feature ensures a straight wheel, consistent brake rotor alignment, and handling stability. Remove the wheel in minutes for an easy and lightweight transport.

Get ultimate stopping power with Star Union hydraulic brakes paired with 180mm rotors (2.3mm thick), making it as easy to stop as it is to go, whether in wet or dry conditions. Paired with ergonomically designed aluminum brake levers for durability.

Lock your trike tires while they aren't in use to keep your ride secure with our front and rear parking brakes. Blue levers on both sides of the handlebars can be micro-adjusted from a locked or unlocked position and engaged with a pull from the brake lever.
A KMC Z8 steel chain offers consistent tension for a secure performance throughout your ride.
16-tooth single-speed freewheel

A removable 48V, 17.5Ah (840 Wh) lithium-ion battery certified to UL 2271 makes for a clean design while powering your ride for up to 70 miles on a single charge.** The XP Trike2 750 is also certified to UL 2849.†

An external charging port provides riders with the option to charge the eBike without removing the battery. The XP Trike2 750 comes standard with a 2amp charger for 7-9 hour charging, but a 5amp Fast Charger can be purchased separately, which can charge the long-range battery in as little as 3.5 hours.

A custom color TFT display featuring a detachable mount and a USB-C port provides trip, battery, & power intelligence on the go. New intuitive drop-down menus make navigating the settings on your eBike easy to understand & allow users to customize their ride settings based on preference. The IP-X5-rated display ensures greater water resistance.
A 750W rear hub motor (1310W peak) with 85 Nm of torque supplies power and speed quicker than ever before. Stealth M24 technology ensures a quieter motor experience without sacrificing power.
Polypropylene fenders protect you and your ride from debris. The flexible material is damage-resistant and helps ensure long-term durability.

The Cloud 50 suspension front fork provides shock absorption for a smooth and cloud-soft ride. Adjust the preload or lock it out to tailor each ride to your preference based on payload capacity and weight distribution.
Ergonomic lock-on grips add comfort so you can ride longer. The plastic sleeve inside helps lock the grips into place and also allows the grips to be easily removed.

An integrated safety system, featuring a new bright 90-lumen headlamp with side amber lights and a brake-activated rear light powered by the internal battery, allows you to be seen at any time of day.
Alert drivers, riders, and people nearby with turn signals. Simply use the left or right arrows on the button pad to turn on the blinkers on either side of the rear light.
Custom-designed 6000 Series Aluminum pedals with protruding grip pins improve foot traction for an optimal experience.
A rear rack integrated into the bike frame holds up to 75 lbs. and features bosses for mounting various accessory combinations.
A custom-designed saddle complements a sporty look while adding comfort so you can ride longer.
Customize the bike to your perfect size by adjusting the seat post height; simply open the quick-release collar and slide the post to your preferred height and lock it in place by closing the collar.

Our proprietary in-house-designed torque sensor programming will give you smoother power distribution and a better riding experience. It is designed to manage power output based on the rider’s pedaling effort. With this programming experience, riders can reach higher speeds easily and with more control than ever before.

Ride longer and more comfortably in an upright cruising position with our new 9-degree stem, which shortens the handlebar reach. Plus, telescoping functionality allows riders to reach a wide range of heights while maintaining comfort and stability.
A half-twist throttle located on the right handlebar delivers pure power on demand.

Puncture-resistant 20” x 2.5” slim tires allow you to turn on a dime, while an updated tread pattern improves efficiency. The sidewall features reflective strips for better visibility at night. Slime is installed to prevent flat tires—at no additional cost.

The 2-wheel-drive, all-wheel braking system is made possible by the open, dual-differential axle. Both the motor and the stationary rotor are centered on the axle, providing power and brakes to both rear wheels. This design ensures stability by creating a balanced center of gravity.
24amp internal controller is IP-X5 rated and potted for weatherproofing and thermal management.
